baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive مَرْدُودُونَ is completed by فِي ٱلْحَافِرَةِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two backward-directed branches reinforce one another: the subjects are acted upon and returned, while the containing destination is itself the first condition or course. The construction therefore depicts forced re-entry into an origin, not merely motion toward a later place.

activation_trace.role: Return to a former place or state supplies the passive backward vector imposed on the speakers.
Return to the first affair or original path identifies al-hafirah as the origin into which that vector leads.

changed_reading.before: The speakers ask whether some future return will happen.
changed_reading.after: They ask incredulously whether they will be forced back inside the original condition or course from which they had departed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَقُولُونَ governs the marked interrogative أَءِنَّا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying can function simultaneously as interrogative supposition and as an avowed position. The verse reports more than words: the question gives a belief posture audible form.

activation_trace.role: Saying that operates like supposition, especially under interrogation, makes the utterance an epistemic challenge.
Saying as belief or doctrine turns the repeated question into a position the speakers inhabit.

changed_reading.before: The verse neutrally quotes a question.
changed_reading.after: The interrogative is a voiced creed of disbelief: its grammar performs the speakers' settled way of construing return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative فِي permits the ح ف ر noun to be heard as a containing, dug-down domain.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinary return branch supplies movement back, while excavation supplies a downward material container. Their combination leaves open a spatial reading in which the feared return is into excavated earth rather than simply back to a prior time.

activation_trace.role: Return to a place supplies motion back toward a material destination.
Digging earth downward supplies the containing depth into which fi can spatialize the return.

changed_reading.before: Al-hafirah is only an idiom for the former condition.
changed_reading.after: The phrase also carries a material shadow: being sent back within excavated ground or a dug-down stratum.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speakers utter مَرْدُودُونَ while challenging the proposition expressed by it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root's rejection branch folds the speech act onto its content: grammatically the speakers imagine themselves as the ones returned, but pragmatically they are returning the proposition as unacceptable. This agent-patient reversal makes the question itself an act of radd.

activation_trace.role: Brought-forth speech provides the act in which the semantic reversal is performed.
Refusal to accept or returning a false claim makes their question itself reject the claimed return.

changed_reading.before: They only describe a return they consider unlikely.
changed_reading.after: In saying 'returned,' they also return the assertion to its speaker as unacceptable, even as the passive form places them under the return they reject.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening chain supplies removal from a settled place, rapid release, free movement, and outcome-oriented management. Against that kinetic sequence, the passive return and excavated domain become one phase of a controlled extraction-and-redeployment cycle; al-hafirah can be the origin or track from which movement begins rather than a terminal hole.

activation_trace.role: Return to a prior place reverses the direction of the opening motions and closes the cycle.
The downward excavation image gives the moving sequence a material point of removal and return.
Uprooting a thing from its settled place supplies the initial displacement from the dug domain.
Rapid pulling and extraction sharpen displacement into a release operation.
Running or swimming supplies unimpeded travel after extraction.
Managing an affair by considering its outcome makes the motions stages of an ordered process.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 is a serial participial chain that progresses from extraction through movement and precedence to management before the focus question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered motion chain and the focus supplies passive return plus excavation; I infer that the same process frames the return as a managed reversal. A live alternative is that 79:1-5 only supplies oath imagery and no resurrection mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Return into excavated earth is a static downward destination.
changed_reading.after: The return belongs to a managed circuit of extraction, release, motion, and re-placement, with al-hafirah functioning as origin or track as well as depth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence gives return an explicit obstacle and transition: one event follows another, bones have decayed, the speakers themselves call the prospect a return, and one voiced rebuke is followed immediately by their presence on the surface. The doubled return language is thus resolved as an abrupt reversal of decomposition rather than gradual travel.

activation_trace.role: Return to a former state names the reversal whose local mechanism the following ayat unfold.
The first condition or path supplies the state recovered after decomposition.
One thing following and arriving after another supplies the two-stroke event sequence.
Decay supplies the material condition that makes the speakers regard reversal as impossible.
Return or repetition after a first occurrence echoes and confirms the backward force of mardudun.
A forceful vocal rebuke supplies the compact command that precipitates the change of state.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from the focus question to decayed bones, a named karrah, one zجرة, and then فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ; the branchless surface term is used only as structural support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decay, repeated return language, a single vocal event, and immediate surface presence; I infer a causal arrow from command to bodily relocation. The live alternative is that the shout merely signals a transformation whose mechanism remains unstated.

changed_reading.before: The verse poses a general possibility of return to an original state.
changed_reading.after: It poses a precise reversal of decay that requires no gradual route: a following event and one command place the decomposed back on the exposed surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence turns voiced denial into a public order: rejection culminates in a claim to highest rank, then seizure spans the later and the first. This makes the focus speakers' interrogative creed socially consequential and lets return to the first condition imply the undoing of self-elevated rank as well as bodily restoration.

activation_trace.role: Saying as doctrine anchors the focus question as a maintained public position.
Return to a prior state supplies the reversal of the order asserted in speech.
The first affair supplies the baseline to which a claimed hierarchy is reset.
Attributing the message to falsehood supplies the narrative's explicit act of rejection.
Greatness as self-exalting domination supplies the rank constructed by the public claim.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies the force that collapses the asserted order.
Laterness after the first extends the reversal across temporal order.
The beginning and first position directly reactivate al-hafirah's first-affair branch.

structural_cues: 79:18, 79:24, and the focus repeatedly stage speech, while 79:21-25 orders rejection, proclamation, and seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a second speech drama ending in reversal across high rank and first/later terms; I infer that it typologically sharpens the anonymous speakers' saying. A live alternative is that Pharaoh is only an independent warning example and does not characterize their speech act.

changed_reading.before: The focus question expresses an isolated intellectual doubt about bodily return.
changed_reading.after: It is also a doctrine that protects a present hierarchy; being returned to the first condition would overturn both the speakers' claim and the rank-world such claims build.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation challenge answers the focus challenge with operations rather than assertion: origination, assembly by joining parts, and completion into a sound form. Returning to the first condition is thereby sharpened into reconstruction of a creatable configuration, not reversal of time alone.

activation_trace.role: Return to a former state names the restoration that the creation operations make materially intelligible.
The first creation or first condition becomes the recoverable design state.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the capacity that underwrites a second formation.
Building by joining parts supplies an explicit assembly mechanism for restoration.
Straightness and completion in the thing itself supplies the finished state reached by reconstruction.

structural_cues: 79:27 opens with another direct interrogative, explicitly comparing the addressees' creation with a larger constructed order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an interrogative comparison followed by creation, assembly, and completion; I infer that these operations answer how the focus return can occur. A live alternative is that the passage proves power by comparison without describing bodily reconstruction.

changed_reading.before: Return to the first state sounds like an unexplained rewinding of existence.
changed_reading.after: Return is re-creation: dispersed material can be joined and completed again according to its first formed configuration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth passage depicts a lower, growth-bearing domain from which concealed water and pasture are brought out. The spring-plant branch of the focus noun therefore turns excavated earth from inert destination into a regenerative matrix: return to al-hafirah can carry the image of seasonal re-emergence.

activation_trace.role: Return to a former state supplies the cyclical restoration enacted through the earth.
The spring plant called hafra supplies a living, seasonal image inside the focus noun.
Soft, growth-bearing earth supplies the matrix in which the focus plant image can operate.
Bringing something out of concealment changes burial-like depth into a source of emergence.
Delivering water supplies the enabling material for renewed growth.
Pasture and grazing growth supply the visible product emerging from the earth.

structural_cues: 79:29-33 moves from concealed night to emitted daylight, then from earth to what is brought out of it, before stabilizing the mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies productive earth, emergence, water, pasture, and a focus-side spring plant; I infer a human-restoration analogy. A live alternative is that this ecology only demonstrates provision and creative power, not the semantics of al-hafirah.

changed_reading.before: The excavated domain is an inert grave-like depth.
changed_reading.after: Al-hafirah can be heard as productive earth: return into it is the hidden phase of a cycle that brings life out again like spring growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: One root anchors mountains in the created ground and later names the hour's anchorage. That material-to-temporal transfer activates the support branch of radd: the focus return can be imagined as detachment from the present ground and reattachment at a fixed eschatological mooring.

activation_trace.role: A support that bears and prevents falling lets mardudun carry the image of being set back onto a sustaining point.
The original course supplies the point to which reattachment returns the subjects.
Firm settling and rootedness make created mountains the material instance of anchorage.
The same firmness image gives the hour a fixed mooring and transfers anchorage into time.

structural_cues: The same ر س و root links the end of the creation passage at 79:32 with the final question sequence at 79:42.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one anchoring root in material and temporal settings plus the focus support branch; I infer a transfer from ground-fixing to event-fixing. A live alternative is that the two r-s-w occurrences are independent conventional uses and do not modify mardudun.

changed_reading.before: Return is only backward movement toward a former state.
changed_reading.after: Return is also re-anchoring: the subjects are removed from present stability and set back at the fixed origin or terminal mooring of the hour.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence joins recovered memory of prior work to forced exposure. This activates hafara as investigation: return to al-hafirah can be a return to the first record, where what the person said, believed, and pursued is excavated and made visible.

activation_trace.role: Saying as belief makes the focus utterance part of the prior inner record potentially recovered.
Digging into and investigating an affair supplies the forensic operation applied to the past.
Recovering something after forgetfulness supplies retrieval of the person's first record.
Work and acquired action provide the content recovered by the investigation.
Disclosure and emergence into view supply the evidentiary exposure that follows recollection.

structural_cues: 79:35 places remembered striving immediately before 79:36's passive disclosure, creating a retrieval-to-exposure sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recollection, prior work, exposure, and the focus investigation branch; I infer that the focus utterance is among the recoverable evidence. A live alternative is that only deeds are recalled and al-hafirah retains no forensic force.

changed_reading.before: Return to the first condition concerns bodily location or form.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean being returned to an excavated record of one's first acts and beliefs, where the skeptical saying itself becomes exposed evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places people in a passive participle: return happens to them. The later clause gives a person an active alternative, restraining the self from its inclination. Radd as checking or repelling therefore opens an ethical temporal contrast between voluntary redirection now and compelled return later.

activation_trace.role: Turning, checking, or preventing supplies the shared motion between external return and self-restraint.
Active checking and restraint supply a present, voluntary form of redirection.
The inward self with reason and apprehension identifies the object and possible agent of present correction.
Inclination of the self supplies the vector that must be checked before the later passive return.

structural_cues: The passive plural participle مَرْدُودُونَ contrasts with active نَهَى taking ٱلنَّفْسَ as its explicit object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passive return and active self-restraint; I infer a now/later choice between self-redirection and imposed redirection. A live alternative is that the moral contrast governs destination only and does not revise the mechanics of return.

changed_reading.before: The speakers ask only what will be done to them after death.
changed_reading.after: Their passive future return is set against a present active return of the self from its own pull: what is not checked voluntarily is ultimately redirected by force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final question sequence advances the focus interrogation from whether return occurs to when the hour is anchored, where its endpoint lies, and how it appears when seen. At perception, the prior stay contracts to a fraction of a day. Al-hafirah's first-condition branch thus becomes a temporal zero point reached when skeptical duration collapses.

activation_trace.role: Interrogative supposition anchors the initial 'whether' question whose terms later change.
Return to a prior state supplies the event whose timing replaces its disputed possibility.
The first condition supplies the temporal origin against which the former stay is finally compressed.
Questioning exchanged between parties extends the focus challenge into the later demand for timing.
Firm settling gives the hour a fixed temporal anchorage despite uncertainty about when.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the hour's controlled endpoint.
Direct sight converts the disputed return from proposition into experienced event.
Staying in a place supplies the duration that collapses retrospectively at sight.

structural_cues: The focus أَءِنَّا, 79:42 أَيَّانَ, and 79:46 كَأَنَّهُمْ form a question-to-perception arc across the whole surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an initial whether-question, a later when-question, a fixed endpoint, sight, and compressed duration; I infer one progressive correction of skeptical temporality. A live alternative is that the questioners at 79:42 need not be identical with the speakers at 79:10.

changed_reading.before: The speakers treat return to the first state as temporally remote enough to doubt.
changed_reading.after: The surah moves their question from whether to when; once the fixed event is seen, elapsed worldly duration collapses and return to the first condition feels immediate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates al-hafirah's dental-decay and milk-tooth replacement branches against the adjacent decayed-bones objection. It remains anchored to the exact focus noun and to the immediate bone, decay, and return sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for replacement after decay, not as the lexical disambiguation of al-hafirah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْحَافِرَةِ carries branches for eroded teeth and for primary teeth falling as others emerge.

activation_trace.role: Erosion and corruption of teeth supply a small bodily model of hard material decaying.
Falling primary teeth and the emergence of replacements supply a visible decay-to-renewal cycle.
Hard bone supplies the larger bodily material to which the dental cycle is analogically transferred.
Decay states the objection that the replacement cycle answers in miniature.
Return after a first occurrence turns replacement into an image of restored embodiment.

changed_reading.before: Decayed bones make bodily return appear materially unintelligible.
changed_reading.after: The focus noun unexpectedly carries a bodily precedent: hard tissue can decay or fall, yet replacement can emerge after it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant م ر د mapping for مَرْدُودُونَ and links its bareness image to extraction and exposure. It remains formally anchored by the supplied split-root inventory and context sequence. Downstream prose must label it a form-distant activation, not claim that mardudun lexically means stripped bare.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps مَرْدُودُونَ not only to ر د د but also to a م ر د inventory whose first branch is removal of covering.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping's image of a thing stripped of what covers it makes the returned body bare and unshielded.
Uprooting from a settled place supplies forceful removal from the former covering domain.
Peeling and taking something out of its skin sharpens removal into stripping.
Disclosure and uncovering supply the final exposed condition of what has been stripped out.

changed_reading.before: The passive participle only means that the speakers are sent back.
changed_reading.after: A form-distant branch imagines that return as extraction from coverings and arrival exposed, with no protective layer left between the person and what is revealed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the commercial idiom of payment 'at the hoof' inside al-hafirah. It remains anchored to the focus noun and gains temporal pressure from the single voiced act immediately followed by surface presence. Downstream prose should qualify it as an immediacy analogy, not translate the verse as a sale or payment scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْحَافِرَةِ has a branch for present settlement or payment at the hoof and at the first encounter.

activation_trace.role: Immediate cash settlement at the hoof supplies an on-the-spot temporal image for al-hafirah.
One forceful vocal rebuke supplies the act at which the return is immediately effected.
Numerical oneness compresses the transition into one undivided event.

changed_reading.before: Return is an unspecified later process.
changed_reading.after: The odd commercial branch makes the return feel settled on the spot: one signal, one act, and the reversal is already present.

strongest_changes: The immediate 79:7-14 sequence converts a generic return into a one-command reversal from decayed bones to exposed presence.
The creation operations in 79:27-28 make return to the first condition intelligible as reassembly and completion.
The closing question sequence shifts skepticism from whether return occurs to when its fixed endpoint arrives, then collapses prior duration at sight.
The earth passage keeps a live exploratory reading of al-hafirah as a regenerative substrate rather than an inert excavated destination.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly changed the same three focus anchors across domains: qawl moved from question to creed and evidence, radd moved from backward motion to reconstruction, checking, and re-anchoring, and hafirah moved among first course, excavation, productive earth, and investigative recovery. The supplied split mapping also preserved a form-distant stripping-and-exposure outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening motion chain may be procedural activation material or only oath imagery; the packet does not settle that relation.
The spatial excavation, ecological growth, forensic investigation, and dental replacement branches remain live analogies rather than disambiguations of al-hafirah.
The analogy between the focus speakers and Pharaoh's speech posture is functional but not an asserted identity.
The non-dominant م ر د activation is explicitly form-distant and should never displace the dominant ر د د reading.
